_comment: Dynamic-bias double tail (flow.comp.layout FLOORPLAN_CASES: the modified double tail's latch, the input pair's tail switched onto C_TAIL, with C_P) in standard-cell rows, top row first, each row mirrored about the centre: C_TAIL (the PMOS capacitor on the cap node, the block's largest device, split over two rows), input pair and tail switch, C_P on the input-pair drains (split cross-quad over two rows, the cap node's charging switch between the first halves), preamp resets, the PMOS latch stack (cross, inner-on), the NMOS latch (cross-coupled pair split cross-quad over two rows), standard-cell output stage. Ten rows: an even count, as every comparator floorplan, so the top row meets the block's edge as theirs do. Netlist: the sweep's (flow.comp.layout.layout_floorplan, standard-cell output stage); no named instance has this structure.
